description:
Month boundaries of a regional calendar for the year. Solar: tamil (sankranti before sunset: that day), malayalam (within the first three fifths of daylight: that day), bengali (between sunrise and midnight: the next day; after midnight: the day after), each month with its sankranti moment, first and last civil day, length and year (Tamil samvatsara, Kollam era, Bangabda). Lunisolar: gujarati (amanta, Vikram Samvat from Kartika, Sud and Vad) and marathi (amanta, Shaka from Chaitra), each month with its new moons, first and last civil day, adhika and kshaya.

[Group: Vedic]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/vedic/calendar/regional/months]
[Required: calendar, year, latitude, longitude]
[Cost: 50 credits (Tier 3)]

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal school by name. Lahiri when omitted. Equivalent to ayanamsaId; send either.

calendar.description: tamil, malayalam, bengali (solar months from the sankranti by each region's rule), gujarati (amanta, Vikram Samvat from Kartika), marathi (amanta, Shaka from Chaitra).

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive. Between -66 and 66: further out the Sun does not rise on some days and a Hindu day has no start.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

timezone.description: IANA zone name such as Asia/Kolkata, America/New_York or Europe/Kyiv, or auto (default) to look it up from the coordinates. Resolved day by day: each day is read on the offset that zone kept that day, so summer time is followed.

timezoneOffset.description: A fixed offset in hours instead of a zone, for the whole year. Ignored when timezone is sent.

year.description: Gregorian year, 1900 to 2100. Entries are those whose date falls in this year.

name: astroway_vedic_calendar_regional_months
title: Regional calendar: month boundaries for a year
